answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a comet bet on surviving 77 epochs of grading, and every forge settlement recomputes the cedar schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 77 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
